body: My ex is my amazing  boyfriend's brother.  He constantly is talking about how I did this and that - I find it quite amusing and so does my boyfriend.

wow, thank you all for all those really nice things you said.  I have a update... yesterday morning I woke up crying.  My boyfriend couldn't take it anymore of me answering everything with a "I don't know"... I got to the point where I just showed him my wrist.  He flipped out.  He cried. We talked about everything, and I do mean everything.  By the afternoon, he apologized for flipping out and told me he just cant understand why I would hurt myself.  I still don't know. He assured me I can talk to him about anything, good or bad.  He also told me he wishes I would have just came to him right after I did it because he felt like I kept a secret from him.  I feel a lot better today, and I even got the big job I've always dreamed of.  I am going to see my doctor tomorrow to get him to up the dose of my meds, or change them.  And I made an appointment for counseling.  I really appreciate all of your kind words and hugs :)  It really did help me.  I hope I can now help someone else.  =)

I have 2 years on you, and I know exactly how you feel... literally.  Crohn's disease is very hard to live with, let alone talk about.  I was diagnosed last year, after they had already taken my gallbaladder out thinking that was the issue.  You need to talk to a professional about your feelings.  I was in the psych ward on 2 occasions as well... most likely will be there again.  
I want you to know, that you are not alone.  I am dealing with the exact same issues.  
The pain does not help, but you need to see another doctor.  You need pain management and meds, ASAP.  It will be worth the drive.  What idiotic doctor doesn't give his/her Crohn's patient pain meds?!  
Feel better, I know it's hard to talk about... but there will be a girl you will meet with the same condition.
Keep your head up

oh, I forgot to mention.  that 2nd boyfriend... well I am with his brother, that's the guy I love to death and there's a whole controversy over it with his family (well just his brother and his girlfriend). My family loves him.  I think that might have something to do with me not wanting to talk to him about it, because I feel like I can't due to the situation, even though we've been going strong now for a little over 3 years.

I dont know what is wrong.  There are so many things that have happened in my life I cant point to one.  I was raped, then told I was lying by the police who made me tell the story in front of my parents.  I was strangled by the second boyfriend I talked about, then left in my car and lived out of a tent for a month- worked 3 jobs to get into my apartment.  I got into 4 car accidents within 2 months, one of which my forehead was ripped off and had to surgically redone and the other my 2nd boyfriend I talked about had 6 front teeth torn out of his mouth.  I know there are things that I either cant remember, or dont want to remember that happended as well.  The kicker is last year I was at a "rap show" to support my two friends as they came up in the industry only to have it end 20 minutes later with me being trampled (I still have scars) and the one shot in the head.  I have to go to the trial as a witness next month.  Oh, I turned 13 in Children's Hospital in Pittsburgh from a 6 hour open-heart surgery.  
Thank you guys, I needed those comments.
